module caesar_cipher (
    input [7:0] data_in,
    output [7:0] data_out
);

    wire [8:0] sum; // 9 bits to hold sum and detect overflow

    assign data_out = sum[7:0];   // Wrap around automatically due to bit slicing

endmodule

);
